outcome.answer: For LLM-based popularity prediction in recommendation, TRAIL is the closest match: it fine-tunes an LLM to predict short-term item popularity and produce natural-language explanations, aligning both with structured trend signals [1]. Other papers address related but different problems: one uses LLMs as explainable re-rankers alongside traditional recommenders [2], while another selectively uses LLM pairwise ranking guidance when it is expected to be reliable, including based on item popularity [3].
